sn22.103:1.4: Usually (eg. [sn22.105]()), these four are presented without being suffixed with _-anta_ (“end”), the contextual meaning of which is not entirely clear. The commentary says _anta_ here means “portion”, but this seems poorly attested. Perhaps the obvious meaning is the correct one: _anta_ means “end”, which in the case of suffering and its origin means death, and in the case of the path and the end of suffering means Nibbana.
